{{Quote|What is it you think you have to ''sell''?''"<br />"''My ''droids''! Superior in ''weaponry'' and ''response time'' to any existing models&mdash;and far more easily and economically ''replaceable''!|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Blayne]]|<ref name="Mask of Iron" />}}
'''Blayne's droids''' were [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] designed by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Blayne]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] model consisted of a [[Human/Legends|Human]] host covered by a mind-controlling [[Blayne's liquid metal|liquid metal]]. The wearer of the [[Armor/Legends|armor]] served as a living bio-battery for the droid body.
